article.title: Stock specifically bequeathed lent to third party on condition that it be replaced.
article.content: Where stock which has been specifically bequeathed is lent to a third party on condition that it shall be replaced, and it is replaced accordingly, the legacy is not adeemed.
article.html:
165Stock specifically bequeathed lent to third party on condition that it be replaced.

Section 165 · Part VI · Chapter XVI · page 58 of the Act

Where stock which has been specifically bequeathed is lent to a third party on condition that it shall be replaced, and it is replaced accordingly, the legacy is not adeemed.
